title: A measure that is a bare column reference is an error: there is no row context

expected.error: A single value for column Amount in table Sales cannot be determined: a column reference needs a row context and a measure has none

source.quote: If you only write a column reference in a DAX measure, you get an error because no row context exists.
source.supports: the article gives SalesAmount := Sales[Amount] as a measure that is not valid
